title: A UTF-32 supplementary character survives a parser refill
summary: All seven prefix lengths recovered both supplementary characters in both UTF-32 byte orders. Shifting the input by one space also agreed with the independent UTF-8 parse.

change.description: The UTF32Reader saves the computed low surrogate when only the high surrogate fits in the current character buffer.

notes: The unavailable snapshot parent POM was rebuilt from Jackson BOM 7796a7ddb240ce41c1b6c6a3a435b29948a6a727.
